goodsServices.description: Electronic, electro technical and electromagnetic modules; data processing equipment, data storage apparatus namely, data processors for scanning, reading, storing and interpreting electronic data contained on RFID [Radio-frequency identification] and NFC [Near-field communication] chips; microprocessors; interfaces for computers; integrated circuits (ICs), chips (integrated circuits); semiconductors; smart cards; smart card integrated circuits; labels, smart cards and tags with integrated RFID [Radio-frequency identification] chips; RFID [Radio-frequency identification] chips and tags; computer hardware and software for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID [Radio-frequency identification] chips and tags; contactless smart cards; dual interface smart cards; dual interface integrated circuits (ICs) that provide a link between contactless cards and contact cards; encoded contactless smart cards containing programming used for determining the fare to be paid by passengers who book their trip electronically; encoded contactless smart cards containing programming used for gaining access to certain areas, buildings, premises, and vehicles; encoded contactless smart cards containing programming used for payment; writers and readers for wireless transmission to and from transponder chips; computer programs for controlling transmission of data to and reading of data from transponder chips; data processing machines for fare determination using transponder chips; Electronic wristbands, namely, electronic readers/recorders for authenticating identity, controlling access to functions, managing events, ticketing, promoting brand loyalty, promoting brands, cashless vending, transportation and membership identification; computer hardware, software and peripheral devices used for access control and authentication purposes; electronic key fobs being remote control apparatus; cloud computing software; cloud computing systems; software for cloud infrastructure; cloud computing platform software; application software for cloud computing services; cloud based digital solutions provider software for managing digitized credentials onto mobile devices and wearable devices supporting NFC-enabled [Near-field communication-enabled] mobile devices for mobile fare payments, mobile transit ticketing, smart card access; digital solutions provider software for the implementation of smartcards on mobile devices and wearable devices; digital solutions provider software for security and risk management in respect of smartcard implementation on mobile devices and wearable devices; digital solutions provider software for virtual card storing on mobile devices and wearable devices embedded on a HCE (Host Card Emulation); digital solutions provider software for virtual card storing on mobile devices and wearable device embedded on a SE (Secure Element); Solutions provider hardware [so-called secure access modules]; interface software; interface circuits for remote devices; secure microprocessors; secure terminals for electronic transactions; secure digital (SD) card readers; Secure Digital (SD) memory cards; software for facilitating secure transactions; SIM cards; SIM cards of mobile NFC [Near-field communication] devices over the air (OTA).

Computer programming services; installation, repair and maintenance in relation to software for creating, programming, controlling, encoding, scanning, reading and interpreting RFID [Radio-frequency identification] chips and tags, and software for determining the fare to be paid by passengers with electronic travel-tickets;
